versions.webuiMismatchTitle: WebUI does not match the current AstrBot version
versions.webuiMismatchMessage: This WebUI may not have been built for the running AstrBot version, so some pages or APIs may behave unexpectedly. Restart AstrBot manually first. If the mismatch remains, delete data/dist in the runtime directory and restart again so AstrBot can download the matching WebUI.
